# FlutterProbe

> FlutterProbe is an end-to-end testing framework for Flutter apps. Tests are written in ProbeScript (.probe files,
> natural-language steps). A Go CLI (`probe`) sends commands to an on-device Dart agent (`flutter_probe_agent`);
> an MCP server (`probe-mcp`) exposes the same capabilities to AI agents.

Key facts for an AI agent:
- Install: `brew install alphawavesystems/tap/probe`; add `flutter_probe_agent` to the app and build with `--dart-define=PROBE_AGENT=true`.
- Run: `probe test tests/ -v --format json -o reports/results.json`.
- Failures look like `line N: <step>: rpc error -3200x: ... visible texts: [...], keys: [...]` — compare the visible texts/keys with the selector you used.
- Wait for each new screen (`wait until "Text" appears`) before tapping; use `#key` selectors; use `scroll down until "X" appears` for rows below the fold.
- OS dialogs (permission alerts, StoreKit sign-in) are not Flutter widgets: use `tap "Allow" in system dialog`, `dismiss system dialog`, `sign in sandbox tester`.
- Devices: every simulator/emulator probe opens is named (`probe device start --platform ios --name <n>`; Android = AVD name) and each test result records device name + id.
- Compatibility (1.x): ProbeScript grammar, probe.yaml, the agent protocol and the report JSON are frozen within 1.x and only grow additively; deprecations last >= 2 minor releases and 90 days; Studio, experimental features and human-readable output are outside the promise (https://flutterprobe.dev/advanced/compatibility/).
- Performance (agent 0.23+): `start measuring "name"` ... `stop measuring`, then `see memory below 300 MB`, `see memory growth below 20 MB`, `see cpu below 60 percent`, `see slow frames below 5 percent`, `see frame time below 16 ms`, `see data transferred below 500 KB`, `see response "/api/x" below 800 ms`. Use profile builds. `probe test --perf-baseline FILE [--perf-update-baseline] [--perf-tolerance 20]` gates regressions; `probe perf trend|compare`; MCP tools perf_trend, perf_compare.
- Waiting: step timeout `--timeout`; `--implicit-wait 7s` retries a missing target; `... within 90 seconds` gives one step its own budget (`wait until "X" appears within 90 seconds`); `optional` / `if visible` fail gracefully; `retry 3 times` re-runs a block; `defaults.retry_failed_tests` re-runs a failing test.
- Backend data (agent 0.22+): `wait for response GET "/api/orders" status 200`, `see response "/api/me" json "data.plan" equals "pro"`, `if response ... otherwise`, `store response ... json "path" as var`, `see exactly 2 requests GET "/x"`, `clear recorded requests`; mocks are real (`respond with 503 after 3 seconds`, `respond with network failure`). Records dart:io traffic only.
- `l10n "key"` is a string from the app's ARB files (probe.yaml `l10n.dir`, `l10n.default`) in the current app language: `tap l10n "saveButton"`. Keys are validated before the run.
- App language: `set language "de"` (also `"pt-BR"`, `"ar"`, `"system"`) relaunches the app in that language (Android 13+, iOS simulator); `probe test --locale de` / `--locales de,ja,ar` run a suite per language.
- Multi-language: prefer `#key` selectors; `--match-loose` folds case/accents/apostrophes in text selectors; `see any of "A", "B"` for per-language labels; system-dialog buttons resolve by role, so `tap "Don't Allow" in system dialog` works on any device language.
- Secrets: only through environment variables (`type "$NAME" into system field "Password"`); they are masked in output.
- AI features (local or hosted models) are optional and never required to run tests.

## Docs
- [Using FlutterProbe from AI agents](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/ai-agents/): the loop, reading failures, rules.
- [ProbeScript syntax](https://flutterprobe.dev/probescript/syntax/)
- [ProbeScript grammar (complete EBNF)](https://flutterprobe.dev/probescript/grammar/): every construct the parser accepts, with a conformance test.
- [Dictionary of steps](https://flutterprobe.dev/probescript/dictionary/)
- [On-device agent](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/agent/): build flags, ports, tokens, RPC methods, troubleshooting.
- [System dialogs](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/system-dialogs/)
- [MCP server (21 tools)](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/mcp/)
- [CLI reference](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/cli-reference/)
- [AI and local models](https://flutterprobe.dev/tools/ai/)
- [Testing localized apps](https://flutterprobe.dev/advanced/multi-language/): keys, loose matching, alternatives, system dialogs in any language.
- [Configuration (probe.yaml)](https://flutterprobe.dev/advanced/configuration/)

## Source
- https://github.com/AlphaWaveSystems/flutter-probe
- Agent package: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_probe_agent
